statement:
Implement `capture_binders(nodes, expr_root, target, replacement_root)`.

`nodes` is a list of immutable term records. Child references are indices into `nodes`. A declaration is `(id, name)`, where `id` is a nonnegative integer and `name` is a string.

Term records are:

- `("var", name)`
- `("call", children)` — all children use the current scope.
- `("bind", declarations, body)` — all declarations scope over `body`.
- `("let", declaration, value, body)` — the declaration scopes over `body`, but not `value`.
- `("match", scrutinee, shared, arms)` — `scrutinee` is outside all arm scopes. `shared` scopes over every arm body, but not auxiliary terms. Each nonempty `arms` list contains:
  - `("ctor", fields, auxiliaries, body)`: `shared` and `fields` scope over `body` only.
  - `("zero", auxiliaries, body)`: `shared` scopes over `body` only.
  - `("succ", predecessor, auxiliaries, body)`: `shared` and `predecessor` scope over `body` only.

Every auxiliary term uses the scope surrounding the whole `match`.

The replacement-rooted term is a tree. The expression-rooted term is instead an acyclic directed graph: a node may have multiple incoming child references. Its meaning for this task is its complete unfolding into a tree, so the same `var` node may represent occurrences under different lexical paths.

Direct substitution replaces every occurrence named `target` whose root-to-occurrence path does not cross an edge introducing a declaration also named `target`. Each replacement is a fresh unfolded copy of the replacement-rooted tree. No alpha-renaming occurs.

An original declaration is capturing if there exists at least one replaced occurrence such that:

- the occurrence's path crosses the scoped edge introducing that declaration, and
- the declaration's name is free in the replacement.

Return the increasing list of IDs of all capturing declarations. This is the minimum set of original declarations that must be renamed to globally fresh names to prevent capture in every unfolding path.

All input is valid. The two roots have disjoint reachable node sets, every listed node is reachable from exactly one root, and the expression graph is acyclic. The replacement root has no parent and every other replacement node has exactly one parent. The expression root has no incoming reference. Declaration IDs are globally unique, and names introduced together on one scoped edge are distinct.

Across both rooted structures there are at most 250,000 nodes and at most 500,000 child references plus declaration-to-scope incidences. Graph paths and replacement-tree depth may be linear in the node count. Names may be long. Only the standard library is allowed.

Return a Python `list[int]`. Do not perform I/O or use global state.
